messages:
jamal: heads-up: pushing a config-only change at midnight PT to nudge routing weights and tighten tinybatch window. no model changes. will be a staged rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m.

maria: ping - what's the exact config payload? any risk to tail latency?

jamal: payload below. expecting slight increase in per-request cpu on edge but should lower p50 for small requests. no kernel/serving restart required.

jamal: ```json
{
  "routing": {
    "default_weight": 0.95,
    "secondary_weight": 0.05,
    "pin_version": null
  },
  "batching": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 1024,
    "batch_window_ms": 12,
    "concurrency_per_gpu": 8
  },
  "timeouts": {
    "request_timeout_ms": 10000,
    "generation_timeout_ms": 8000
  },
  "rate_limits": {
    "tenant_qps": 1200
  }
}
```

sasha: rollback plan? if kv cache pressure spikes we should pin back to previous batch_window_ms 20 and restore weights. who will monitor?

jamal: good call. rollback steps: 1) abort rollout in deploy-bot 2) apply emergency config (batch_window_ms:20, default_weight:1.0) 3) open incident channel if >5% error spike. I will be watching metrics.

maria: ok add to release notes: "config-only: tighten batch window to 12ms, adjust routing to favor default variant; staged rollout; rollback plan included"

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary -> 5% (stage-1) by jamal. command: `/deploy config apply --file midnight-sluice.json --stages 5,25,100 --change-window 00:00-02:00` :rocket:

ops-bot: monitor checks registered: p50_latency, p99_latency, error_rate, kvcache_pressure. alert thresholds set (error_rate>1% OR p99>1200ms).

jamal: stage-1 live. looks clean so far (0.2% error, p99 steady). holding 10m then will push 25%.

maria: FYI compliance asked for a note about no model/data changes -> good.

deploy-bot: progressed to 25% (stage-2). no alerts.

jamal: pushing to 100% now. final check: rollforward unless any of ops-bot alerts fire in next 15m.

sasha: I'll stay near slack for rollback go/no-go. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout complete -> 100% success. staging tags: midnight-sluice-v1 applied.

jamal: closing thread. will file short postmortem if anything flares. thanks all.
